events.subtitle: MIKA NAKASHIMA LIVE at BLUE NOTE TOKYO 2026 — 25th debut anniversary
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo announced on August 27, 2026 that Mika Nakashima will perform at the club on November 7 and 8, 2026, describing the engagement as a premium live marking her 25th debut anniversary. November 7 is exactly 25 years after the November 7, 2001 release of her debut STARS EP. Blue Note Tokyo lists a music charge of ¥26,000 including one plate and one drink, with Jam Session member web reservations opening September 30 at noon and general web reservations opening October 3 at noon. The announcement does not yet publish set times or supporting personnel.

enrichment.note: Exact Blue Note Tokyo announcement and exact Apple Music page for the debut STARS EP are verified. The announcement gives dates, anniversary framing, price and reservation-opening dates but not set times or supporting personnel. A stable event-specific purchase destination is not yet available, so no generic or session-dependent reservation URL is substituted.

sources.note: Official new-show announcement confirms November 7-8, 2026, 25th-anniversary framing, ¥26,000 music charge including one plate and one drink, and reservation-opening dates.
Exact page for Mika Nakashima's STARS EP confirms the November 7, 2001 release date, establishing the exact 25-year anniversary on the first Blue Note Tokyo night.

Official Blue Note Tokyo live report documents a prior Mika Nakashima engagement at the club, relevant to the scarcity check: the 2026 anniversary is meaningful but the venue relationship is not unprecedented.

provenance.note: Dates, anniversary framing, price and reservation-opening dates were verified from Blue Note Tokyo's August 27 announcement; the exact 2001 debut-date anchor was verified from Apple Music; a prior Blue Note Tokyo engagement was verified from the venue's own 2024 report. Repository search found no existing Mika Nakashima record before publication. No showtimes, sidemen or purchase destination were inferred.

en.why_it_matters: The first night lands exactly 25 years after STARS, turning the anniversary into a real date rather than generic tour branding. Blue Note Tokyo also compresses a career usually associated with large-scale Japanese pop into a club room where Nakashima's breath, phrasing and control of space become the primary instrument. The current announcement does not yet reveal the arrangements or band, so the reason to care is the exact career milestone and setting rather than an invented jazz configuration.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room if this overlaps a Tokyo stay, with November 7 clearly the more meaningful of the two nights because it is the exact debut anniversary. The two-night engagement and Nakashima's documented prior Blue Note Tokyo appearances make it a strong city anchor rather than a reason to rebuild an entire Japan trip around one scarce opportunity.

es.why_it_matters: La primera noche cae exactamente 25 años después de STARS, así que el aniversario tiene una fecha real y no es sólo branding de gira. Blue Note Tokyo además comprime una carrera normalmente asociada con el pop japonés de gran escala dentro de una sala de club, donde el aire, el fraseo y el manejo del espacio de Nakashima se vuelven el instrumento principal. El anuncio todavía no revela arreglos ni banda, así que la razón para entrar es el hito exacto y el contexto, no una supuesta configuración jazzística que no está confirmada.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente si coincide con una estancia en Tokio, y escogería claramente el 7 de noviembre porque es el aniversario exacto del debut. Las dos noches y las apariciones previas documentadas de Nakashima en Blue Note Tokyo hacen de esto una muy buena ancla dentro de la ciudad, no una razón para reconstruir todo un viaje a Japón alrededor de una oportunidad escasa.
